turns.user_message: Hi, I'm Dave. Looking for dinner recommendations.
turns.agent_response:
Welcome to Mohegan Sun, Dave. For dinner this evening, I'd suggest SolToro Taqueria & Tequila Bar located in the Casino of the Earth. It has a wonderful, lively energy and some of the best street tacos and house-made ceviche on the property. 

They are open until 10:00 PM tonight, and since it is a casual spot, you won't need a reservation. After you've finished your meal, the Wolf Den usually has live music and is just a short walk away. 

Are you looking for a high-energy atmosphere or something a bit more relaxed?
